Class OrderTile

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.board.OrderTile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OrderTile extends Object implements Serializable
The turn-order track for a game session. Holds an ordered list of OrderCells; each cell records which player occupies it and the bonus/malus that applies when a player's totem is placed there after executing their action.

At the start of each round players are read from this track in order to determine who places their totem first in TotemPlacementState. After each action the acting player's totem moves from the offer track back to the next free cell on this tile.
